entry.author: Whangarei District Council
entry.summary:
Here’s an update from Mayor Ken Couper, Civil Defence Controller Victoria Harwood, Rōpata Diamond of the Ngātiwai Trust Board and NRC Chair Pita Tipene on today’s outreach to affected communities.  

We hosted a visit by Prime Minister Luxon, who was accompanied by Minister of Emergency Management and Recovery Mark Mitchell, and our local MPs. This was an opportunity for them to see the extent of the impact of this week’s storm events and discuss recovery efforts. 

Mayor Couper also acknowledged the tragic news announced this afternoon from Tauranga, passing on aroha to the families and response agencies involved in the search and recovery efforts.  

For more information on our response efforts:  
https://www.wdc.govt.nz/Community/Civil-Defence/Latest-updates
